cases.name: closing level light: two production files added, no rule matched, no ripple, no next batch

closing level full: a modified authorisation file and a modified approved snapshot (an added one does not count); the next sheet naming a changed type keeps its review; --record writes the closing line
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/cl-{{SID}}; W=$R/run/.work.jsonl; rm -rf $R && mkdir -p $R/src/A/Security $R/tests/T $R/todo && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && printf 'class Guard {}
' > src/A/Security/Guard.cs && printf 'class H {}
' > src/A/H.cs && printf 'v0
' > tests/T/X.verified.txt && printf '# S
' > todo/X-PLAN-F1.md && git add -A && git commit -qm init && cd {{ROOT}} && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/batch-baseline.py snapshot $W F1 --root $R >/dev/null && L(){ python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/closing-level.py $R/todo/X-PLAN-F1.md $W --root $R "$@"; } && printf 'class Guard { int x; }
' > $R/src/A/Security/Guard.cs && printf 'v1
' > $R/tests/T/X.verified.txt && printf 'v0
' > $R/tests/T/New.verified.txt && printf '# F2
Uses `Guard` and H.
' > $R/todo/X-PLAN-F2.md && out=$(L --next $R/todo/X-PLAN-F2.md --record) && echo "$out" | jq -r '.level, (.reasons | join(" ; ")), .review, .reviewWhy' | tr '
' '|' && jq -r 'select(.kind == "closing") | .level' $W

expect.stdout: full|authorisation: `src/A/Security/Guard.cs` ; approved snapshot: `tests/T/X.verified.txt`|true|the next sheet names types this batch changed: Guard|full

cases.name: closing level full past the production cap of the repo's kit.config.json, a deleted file counted; a next sheet naming none of the changed types skips its review
closing level: a sheet asking for light lifts the production cap and the ripple, never a matched rule (the request refused, named)

expect.stdout: light|full|authorisation: `src/A/Security/Guard.cs` ; sheet: `closing` set to light, refused — a rule above is never lifted|

cases.name: closing level without a snapshot of the batch exits 2
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/cl0-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R && mkdir -p $R && cd $R && git init -q && cd {{ROOT}} && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/closing-level.py $R/X-PLAN-F1.md $R/w.jsonl --root $R
